summary: Iter 29 — security fixes in backend/routes_payments.py + Diretor propor_correcao. Backend pytest 5/5 in 8.2s: (1) GET /api/payments/status/{sid} without token -> 401; admin -> 200; owner (influencer) -> 200; other user (partner) -> 403 (created a real Stripe checkout session via POST /api/payments/checkout with a premium ebook lookup_key from GET /api/ebooks); non-existent id -> 404. (2) POST /api/stripe/webhook body '{}' no signature -> 400 (WEBHOOK_SECRET is configured, so not 503). (3) GET /api/ebooks/{id}/pdf?auth=<valid token> with no Authorization header -> 401; with Authorization header -> 200/403 (no longer 401). (4) POST /api/diretor/conversar 'Chama a função propor_correcao ...' -> acoes_pendentes contains tipo_acao=propor_correcao; POST /api/diretor/acoes/{id}/aprovar -> resultado.patch_file starts with 'memory/patches/' and file exists on /app/memory/patches/; GET /api/diretor/acoes?status=aprovada includes it. Frontend E2E: admin login -> /admin/diretor -> created propor_correcao via API -> card shows tipo label 'Correção de código', <pre data-testid='acao-diff-{id}'> block with unified diff visible; Aprovar -> toast 'Ação executada', moved to Aprovadas tab with resultado JSON containing 'memory/patches/...' patch_file. Zero console errors (only a benign WS reconnect warning).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_payments.payment_status: coupon_pay branch continues to be public with masked email — OK. Consider adding a rate-limit per session_id since it triggers stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve on each unauthenticated hit for coupon_pay (potential Stripe API burn).

routes_payments.read_pdf: removed ?auth= query token — good security fix. However user_from_query_or_header still accepts an 'auth' param signature; the second arg is always None. Consider removing the unused parameter to reduce misuse risk.

routes_diretor._executar propor_correcao: os.path.basename(str(d.get('ficheiro'))) prevents path traversal in filename — good. But 'diff' content is written verbatim; consider size cap (e.g., 200KB) to avoid large payloads filling /app/memory/patches.
routes_diretor.propor_correcao is added to WRITE_ACTIONS — correctly queued. TIPO map in Diretor.jsx already includes 'propor_correcao': 'Correção de código'. Consistent.
Diretor.jsx line 91 renders raw JSON.stringify(a.resultado) inline — long patch_file strings overflow the pill; consider truncating or using a code block similar to the diff pre for approved actions.
seed_data_creation: Test-created: 1 Stripe checkout session (initiated, never paid — will expire on Stripe side); 2 propor_correcao pending actions during backend + UI tests (both approved & cleaned; patch files removed from /app/memory/patches). No persistent test pollution beyond the payment_transactions initiated row (harmless).
